run_hydra_app: run the Hydra app my_app that prints the config as YAML to stdout
create_hydra_main_app: create a Python app decorated with @hydra.main that loads a config and prints it as YAML
test_my_app: test the my_app function to verify it prints the Hydra config as YAML output
review_hydra_config_printing: review the my_app function that uses OmegaConf.to_yaml to print the Hydra DictConfig
refactor_my_app: refactor the my_app function to customize the output format of the Hydra configuration
